title: "she went down for her nap" with two visible nap events for the SAME child -> dedup collapses to one candidate, resolved binding, never a 1-option question
contractSource: art_gCDrtx4S section 5, F-AX-CLARIFY-001 — dedup-before-count refinement (PR #28 review finding F1)

scenario.narrative: Mom dictates 'she went down for her nap' with the child picker empty (currentChild absent) and two visible nap events in references - both bound to the SAME child. The candidates dedup by kind:targetId BEFORE the count checks, so the two references collapse to a single child candidate. One candidate is the resolver's normal binding path: the outcome is a resolved binding with provenance recorded - never a clarification question with a single option (the schema pins clarification options to 2-4).

envelope.utterance: she went down for her nap

expected.basis: sole visible candidate in envelope context
